reason: Tab. 4.25 (p.115) is the Sachbilanz of the Swiss low-voltage at-grid module — the medium-voltage electricity input, the low-voltage transmission network, the SF6 emission and the distribution losses — which is the structure of every 'Electricity, low voltage, <route>, at grid (CH)' dataset including this import-from-Italy variant; only the upstream medium-voltage electricity differs. Tab. 4.24 (p.114) gives the input data feeding it. Tab. 3.42/3.43 (p.46) give the Italian production and supply mixes, but those describe the Italian generation portfolio, not the low-voltage grid exchanges this dataset carries.
